title: Renumber phase headings to integer + (RX) form
objective: Rename each '## Phase RN — ...' heading in recovery_plan_latex_contract.md to '## Phase <integer> — ... (RN)', so Aut_Faciam parses sequential integer phase IDs while preserving the R-label as legacy traceability.

plan_assets.asset_description: Per-phase heading rename instructions with target line numbers in recovery plan

scope: Edit only the seven '## Phase R*' headings in dev/plans/recovery_plan_latex_contract.md
Do not change any other prose in those phase sections
implementation_steps: For each of the seven phase headings (R0..R6) locate the line
Replace '## Phase RN — <text>' with '## Phase <integer> — <text> (RN)' using the mapping from P1-1
Confirm headings remain in execution order 1..7 top-to-bottom
Verify no inline references like 'see Phase R3' break — leave inline references for amendment 5 to handle
deliverables: Seven renamed phase headings in dev/plans/recovery_plan_latex_contract.md
Each heading carries both the canonical integer phase number and the legacy R-label
acceptance_criteria: grep -E '^## Phase [0-9] —' dev/plans/recovery_plan_latex_contract.md returns exactly seven lines
Each of those lines ends with '(R<digit>)'
Phase numbers appear in strictly increasing order from top to bottom

cases: Heading enumeration matches expected mapping from P1-1
All seven phases present and ordered 1..7
Legacy R-label preserved in parentheses on each heading

risks: Mass find/replace could damage 'Phase RN' references inside body prose — mitigated by editing only lines that begin with '## '
completion_notes: Renumbered 7 phase headings to ## Phase N — ... (RX) form; updated Recommended execution order bullets accordingly; test_p1_2 passes 3/3.
